name: feature
summary: Add a feature or behavior to an existing codebase

steps.goal: List the entry points, modules, tests and config the feature touches, with one line per path
steps.verify: open three of the listed paths and confirm they are what the map says

steps.goal: Pick the approach and split the change into lanes with disjoint owns, interfaces and one verify check per lane
steps.verify: every lane owns files no other lane owns, and every path in the map is covered or ruled out
steps.skip_when: the change fits in one lane or the user already gave the design

steps.goal: Implement one lane of the design
steps.verify: the lane's verify check from the design
steps.fan_out: one subtask per lane in the design, ids build-<lane>

steps.goal: Update the README, docs and changelog for the new behavior
steps.verify: every command and flag in the new text runs or exists in the code

steps.goal: Review the combined diff for correctness against the task
steps.verify: each finding has file:line and a trigger

steps.goal: Reproduce each build lane's verified claim with an independent command
steps.verify: a verdict per claim with the command and its output
